git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Reject unknown fields in config instead of silently using defaults

Previously, typos in .bivvy/config.yml field names (e.g. "stpes"
instead of "steps") were silently ignored due to serde's default
behavior, causing the app to fall back to default config values
without any warning. Add deny_unknown_fields to all config structs
that use serde(default) so that unrecognized fields now produce a
clear parse error pointing to the typo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
